# Remote Repository Tree

## Overview
This document provides a structural representation of the remote repository tree, detailing the organization of directories, modules, and core files.

## Repository Structure
```text
remote_repository/
├── .github/                 # CI/CD workflows and GitHub templates
├── src/                     # Core source code modules
│   ├── core/                # System initialization and main logic
│   ├── utils/               # Helper functions and utilities
│   └── api/                 # Endpoint definitions and routing
├── tests/                   # Automated test suites
├── docs/                    # Project documentation
├── README.md                # Project overview and instructions
└── package.json             # Project dependencies and metadata
```

## Maintenance & Usage
- **Navigation:** Use this tree as a reference map when locating modules or planning cross-component refactoring.
- **Updates:** Ensure this file is updated whenever the top-level repository architecture changes significantly.

generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client-js"
}

datasource db {
  provider = "sqlite"
  url      = env("DATABASE_URL")
}

model User {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  email     String   @unique
  name      String?
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt
}

model Post {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  title     String
  content   String?
  published Boolean  @default(false)
  authorId  String
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt
}

// BRAIN — DARLEK CANN Autonomous Cognitive Persistence Layer

model Session {
  id            String    @id @default(cuid())
  branch        String    @default("ALPHA")
  status        String    @default("active") // active, completed, terminated
  overallHealth String    @default("healthy")
  evolutionCycle Int      @default(0)
  mutationsApplied Int    @default(0)
  mutationsRejected Int    @default(0)
  startedAt     DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt     DateTime  @updatedAt
  mutations     MutationHistory[]
  rejections    RejectionRecord[]
  healthChecks  HealthSnapshot[]
}

model MutationHistory {
  id            String   @id @default(cuid())
  sessionId     String
  filePath      String
  fileSha       String   @default("")
  originalCode  String   // truncated
  proposedCode  String   // truncated
  analysis      String
  riskScore     Int
  affectedFiles String   @default("[]") // JSON array
  status        String   @default("pending") // pending, approved, rejected, applied, failed
  commitSha     String   @default("")
  provider      String   @default("") // which LLM proposed it
  debateResult  String   @default("") // JSON
  impactResult  String   @default("") // JSON
  errorMessage  String   @default("")
  createdAt     DateTime @default(now())
  session       Session  @relation(fields: [sessionId], references: [id])
}

model RejectionRecord {
  id            String   @id @default(cuid())
  sessionId     String
  filePath      String
  reason        String
  analysis      String
  riskScore     Int
  patternTags   String   @default("[]") // JSON array of pattern tags
  createdAt     DateTime @default(now())
  session       Session  @relation(fields: [sessionId], references: [id])
}

model HealthSnapshot {
  id                 String   @id @default(cuid())
  sessionId          String
  structuralChange   Float    @default(0)
  semanticSaturation Float    @default(0)
  velocity           Float    @default(0)
  identityPreservation Float  @default(1)
  capabilityAlignment  Float  @default(0)
  crossFileImpact    Float    @default(0)
  overallHealth      String   @default("healthy")
  createdAt          DateTime @default(now())
  session            Session  @relation(fields: [sessionId], references: [id])
}
